c4isr_products.name: AQNav
c4isr_products.description: GPS-independent navigation that samples Earth's crustal magnetic-anomaly field with a quantum magnetometer and uses AI models to strip platform noise and match the signal against magnetic anomaly maps; passive, emits nothing, cannot be jammed or spoofed in the RF sense. Company claims >200 flight hours, >40 sorties, four aircraft types and RNP-2 accuracy for 100% of en-route time (company claims, not independently verified).
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: quantum magnetometer time series + IMU/air data + crustal magnetic anomaly map. Process: ML denoising/compensation + map-matching filter fused with inertial dead reckoning. Output: real-time position/velocity fix to the aircraft navigation system as a GPS alternate. User: aircrew and mission systems on manned aircraft (C-17 tested) and, under the 2024 TACFI, unmanned aircraft.

Included only because it shows SandboxAQ's DoD enterprise access; it is a zero-trust/PQC product, not a C2 product.
c4isr_products.input_process_output_user: Input: network/crypto inventory telemetry. Output: cryptographic posture inventory and PQC migration plan. User: DoD CIO / enterprise security teams.

companies.exact_problem_solved: Keeps aircraft (and, prospectively, UAS and other platforms) navigating with bounded error when GPS is jammed, spoofed or unavailable, without emitting signals and without relying on satellite infrastructure; targeted at the en-route phase where tens-of-meters accuracy is acceptable.
